title: 带模型子目录
code:
demoDir=$(mktemp -d "$HOME/foam-make-demo.XXXXXX")
(
    cd "$demoDir" || exit 1
    mkdir -p nested nested/models
    touch nested/main.C nested/models/model.C
    cd nested
    "$WM_PROJECT_DIR/wmake/scripts/makeOptions"
    cat Make/options
)
explanation: 源码分组位于 models，默认选项仍需补充项目自定义 include。 末行显示实际生成内容。

title: 多文件工具
code:
demoDir=$(mktemp -d "$HOME/foam-make-demo.XXXXXX")
(
    cd "$demoDir" || exit 1
    mkdir -p multi
    touch multi/main.C multi/readData.C multi/writeData.C
    cd multi
    "$WM_PROJECT_DIR/wmake/scripts/makeOptions"
    cat Make/options
)
explanation: 三份实现共享该默认选项，所需额外库再补入 EXE_LIBS。 末行显示实际生成内容。
